title: What federation adds, class by class
decision: What does the federated model add over the architecture model, per class, and does anything in the architecture model go missing?

data.note: Duplex Apartment architecture model (duplex.ifc): every IFC product with its class and STEP id
Duplex Apartment federated model: architecture, MEP, electrical, and rooms and spaces files in one BOS, each kept as its own document
The comparison is computed by this demo's main.ts on every load (counts per upper-cased class, STEP ids matched inside the architecture document); no file stores it
